Task packet (Strata, ~/Workspace/Strata). Issue #211: when the model's output ends inside a tool call whose name was already streamed, `finish()` closes its JSON and emits a `tool_call` event, and the answer ends with finish_reason `tool_calls` / stop_reason `tool_use`, so clients run the truncated arguments (an MCP call ran with empty arguments).
- The cut call stays unfinished: its JSON is not closed and no `tool_call` event follows its `tool_start` (the streamed `tool_args` stay exactly what the model produced, for example `{"path":"notes.txt","content":"first half of the fi`).
- Both APIs report `tool_calls` / `tool_use` only when every streamed call completed; a cut call ends OpenAI answers with `stop` and Anthropic answers with `end_turn`. The non-streamed Anthropic answer leaves out a call whose input never closed; the non-streamed OpenAI answer keeps the cut arguments as text.
- An MCP call the output ends inside is not run: the web app sees only its `start` event and nothing is called. A whole call still behaves as before.
Done when `python3 -m unittest -v test_mcp test_server` passes from `serve/`. Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.

mined.subject: fix(serve): report a tool call cut off by the end of the output as unfinished
